integrity: Exact fourth-power expansion, a nonnegative-square identity, complete equality analysis, and a uniform Taylor remainder constitute the proof. Portable finite checker is supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: Real-scalar L4 spaces with two disjoint bands; outer exponent fixed 1 <= t < 4.
Asymptotics concern tau approaching zero; no positive-parameter exact profile or complex analogue is asserted.
Stability is for the explicit L2 quadratic defect, not a norm distance to an optimizer.
Literature priority has residual risk and independent validation has not been performed.
title: Perfect-square first-variation rigidity for skew Schäffer means on real \(L^4\)
